title: pairs_from_two_lists
prompt: Given two same-length lists a and b, return a list of tuples pairing up the elements at each position. e.g. a=[1, 2, 3], b=['x', 'y', 'z'] returns [(1, 'x'), (2, 'y'), (3, 'z')].
hint: zip() pairs up two sequences elementwise into tuples - wrap it in list() to see the pairs.
